card.name: Avoid and contraindicated-in wording
card.fires_on: Small words right after "contraindicated" ("in") or "avoid/avoiding" ("the", "avoiding") in label instructions. Also fires on "if" after "Do not use X".

modes.description: "avoiding" or "the" after "avoid", when directing application away from eyes, lips or other sites.

modes.label: Do not use if
modes.description: "if" after a "Do not use" statement about product condition.
